collections.name: Person
collections.sentence: A person is anyone we know: a member, someone who came to a session, someone we wrote to.
notHeld: every exchange with the course platform is logged, and a skipped one says why

a rule across records (at most one) is none of the store’s checks, which are each on one row; ONT-013 step 4 measures it

notHeld.says: a retired value stays on the records that hold it, and is no longer offered

the schema has no rule that follows a link from record to record
